question: Can you calculate the 5-day symmetric moving average of predicted toy sales for December 5 to 8, 2018, using daily sales data from January 1, 2017, to August 29, 2018, with a simple linear regression model? Finally provide the sum of those four 5-day moving averages?
sql:
-- Complete solution: build regression from data, predict, calculate moving averages, and sum
WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS sale_date,
        SUM(oi.price) AS daily_sales
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_category_name = 'brinquedos'
        AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) >= '2017-01-01'
        AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) <= '2018-08-29'
    GROUP BY CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)
),
date_range AS (
    SELECT UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(DATE '2017-01-01', DATE '2018-08-29', INTERVAL '1' DAY)) AS calendar_date
),
joined AS (
    SELECT dr.calendar_date, COALESCE(ds.daily_sales, 0) AS daily_sales
    FROM date_range dr
    LEFT JOIN daily_sales ds ON dr.calendar_date = ds.sale_date
),
with_day_num AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_date,
        daily_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY calendar_date) AS day_num
    FROM joined
),
reg_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(daily_sales, day_num) AS slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(daily_sales, day_num) AS intercept
    FROM with_day_num
),
-- Last day of training data is day 606 = 2018-08-29
-- Dec 5, 2018 is 98 days after Aug 29, so day_num = 606 + 98 = 704
predictions AS (
    SELECT DATE '2018-12-03' AS pred_date, 702 AS day_num
    UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2018-12-04', 703
    UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2018-12-05', 704
    UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2018-12-06', 705
    UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2018-12-07', 706
    UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2018-12-08', 707
    UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2018-12-09', 708
    UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2018-12-10', 709
),
pred_with_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.pred_date,
        p.day_num,
        (SELECT slope FROM reg_stats) * p.day_num + (SELECT intercept FROM reg_stats) AS predicted_sales
    FROM predictions p
),
moving_avgs AS (
    SELECT 
        p.pred_date,
        p.predicted_sales,
        AVG(p2.predicted_sales) AS moving_avg_5day
    FROM pred_with_sales p
    JOIN pred_with_sales p2 ON p2.day_num BETWEEN p.day_num - 2 AND p.day_num + 2
    WHERE p.pred_date IN (DATE '2018-12-05', DATE '2018-12-06', DATE '2018-12-07', DATE '2018-12-08')
    GROUP BY p.pred_date, p.predicted_sales
)
SELECT SUM(moving_avg_5day) AS total_sum FROM moving_avgs
